# Adele Carpenter

> Adele Carpenter is a software engineer and consultant at Trifork Amsterdam, and an international technical conference speaker (NDC, GOTO, Devoxx, JavaZone). Her talks bring context to everyday engineering decisions: why we do things the way we do, and whether we have to.

- Works mostly in the JVM/Spring and React ecosystems, on systems for the educational sector, and as a trusted advisor to Trifork's customers.
- Speaking style: real-world customer projects, experiences outside tech, and storytelling, with good humour.
- Outside work: competitive powerlifting.
- To invite Adele to speak, use her Sessionize profile (current sessions, abstracts and past events).
